purpose: Ordered golden case list. Case file shape: {files: {relpath: body}, expected_rows: [...]} -- bodies are JSON-encoded strings. expected_rows are canonical normalised rows (derived ids incl., created_timestamp and producer_version excluded, None columns dropped), sorted by table then event_id. golden_digest = sha256 over, for each case in this order, the case basename, a newline and json.dumps(expected_rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False), newline-joined.
